battle.name: 第二次蘇丹內戰
battle.brief: 第二次蘇丹內戰於1983年爆發，初期戰鬥主要發生在蘇丹南部的赤道州與上尼羅州，地方武裝對抗政府軍。同時期英國海軍已列裝1877年的Torpedo boat，可用於近岸巡邏、港口警戒及快速反應。

kit.name: 魚雷艇
kit.history: 魚雷艇在英國海軍體系中負責近岸警戒、港口防禦與快速巡邏，並可視任務協同驅逐艦或主力艦，補足大型艦艇的反應速度。

countries: 主要交戰方是喀土穆的蘇丹政府與蘇丹人民解放運動（SPLM/A）及其武裝蘇丹人民解放軍（SPLA）。政府方面在1983年由加法爾·尼邁里掌控，1985年軍事政變後由阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·斯瓦爾·達哈卜主持過渡，1986年由薩迪克·馬赫迪組閣，1989年奧馬爾·巴希爾推翻馬赫迪後，戰事仍延續至2000年。SPLA一方在1991年分裂出赤道軍團，其後形成SPLA北方部隊，因此後期同時存在政府軍對抗SPLA，以及SPLA主派對抗分裂派的戰線。埃塞俄比亞在戰爭頭十年提供邊境營地、訓練與後勤，1991年後其政策轉變；厄立特里亞後來參與斡旋。奈及利亞、肯亞與政府間非洲發展局承辦談判，乍得內戰則使蘇丹南部邊境與乍得戰線互相牽動。
countriesEn: The principal belligerents were the government in Khartoum and the Sudan People's Liberation Movement/A (SPLM/A), together with its armed force, the Sudan People's Liberation Army (SPLA). On the government side, power was held by Gaafar Nimeiry in 1983, followed by the transitional administration of Abdel Rahman Swar al-Dahab after the 1985 military coup and by Sadiq al-Mahdi from 1986. Omar al-Bashir overthrew al-Mahdi in 1989, but the fighting continued until 2000. The SPLA split in 1991 with the emergence of the Equatoria Corps and, subsequently, SPLA-North, so the later war included government forces fighting the SPLA as well as the main SPLA faction fighting breakaway groups. Ethiopia provided border camps, training, and logistics during the first decade, but changed its policy after 1991. Eritrea later participated in mediation efforts. Nigeria, Kenya, and the Intergovernmental Authority on Development hosted negotiations, while the civil war in Chad linked the southern Sudanese border to the Chadian front.
people: 指揮鏈顯示這是一場由分裂的南方軍隊起義、演變成國家軍與政治軍事組織長期對抗的戰爭。1983年5月，約翰·加朗在皮博爾被尼邁里政府指為兵變策劃者；他與核心幕僚越境進入埃塞俄比亞後，逐步成為SPLA的軍事領導者，後來兼任SPLM/A主席與SPLA總司令。約瑟夫·拉古、薩爾瓦·基爾等人參與建立早期縱隊，基爾並在後來成為加朗在SPLA內部的主要協助者。1991年，赤道軍團在拉姆·阿孔與保羅·馬隆領導下宣布自治，加朗則保住南部與上尼羅爾地區的主要兵力；經過1993至1994年的內戰，拉古與馬隆另立SPLA北方部隊。政府一線的指揮者先後是尼邁里、達哈卜、馬赫迪與巴希爾；薩迪克·馬赫迪曾推動停火談判，而哈桑·圖拉比領導的國家伊斯蘭陣線反對削弱政府的戰爭權力。
peopleEn: The chain of command shows that this was a long conflict between the state and a political-military organization, beginning with the mutiny of southern troops and expanding into conventional war. In May 1983, John Garang was accused by Nimeiry's government of orchestrating the mutiny at Pibor. After crossing into Ethiopia with his core associates, he gradually became the principal military leader of the SPLA and later served as both chairman of the SPLM/A and commander in chief of the SPLA. Joseph Lagu, Salva Kiir, and others helped establish the early columns, with Kiir later becoming Garang's main associate inside the SPLA. In 1991, the Equatoria Corps declared autonomy under Lam Akon and Paul Malong, while Garang retained the main body of forces in Equatoria and Upper Nile. Fighting between the factions in 1993 and 1994 led Lagu and Malong to establish SPLA-North. On the government side, command passed from Nimeiry to Swar al-Dahab, then to Sadiq al-Mahdi, and finally to Omar al-Bashir. Al-Mahdi promoted ceasefire negotiations, whereas Hassan al-Turabi's National Islamic Front opposed any arrangement that reduced the government's ability to wage war.
kits: 以1983年或更早已列裝的型號為準，政府軍的骨幹是蘇系裝備，包括T-55坦克、BMP-1裝甲步兵車、BTR-60與BTR-70裝甲運兵車、BRDM-2偵察車，以及D-30和BM-21的122毫米榴砲。MiG-21負責對地攻擊與偵察攝影，Mi-8擔任運輸和聯絡，ZU-23與SA-2構成野戰和機場防空。SPLA早期以步兵作戰，使用AKM、AK-4、PKM、RPK、SVD Dragunov狙擊槍、DShK重機槍、RPG-7火箭筒及82毫米、120毫米迫擊砲；後來也從埃塞俄比亞補充裝備，並繳獲T-55、BMP-1等車輛，形成由營、旅向師級發展的地面部隊。彈藥消耗集中在7.62×39毫米步槍彈、7.62×54毫米通用機槍彈、12.7×54毫米重機槍彈與122毫米砲彈。Ural-375、ZIL-131及GAZ-66卡車負責油料、給水和前線補給，但輪胎、柴油與連續運補能力常比射擊更直接決定機動範圍。
kitsEn: Using only types fielded by 1983 or earlier, the government's principal equipment was Soviet-pattern: T-55 tanks, BMP-1 infantry fighting vehicles, BTR-60 and BTR-70 armored personnel carriers, BRDM-2 reconnaissance vehicles, and D-30 and BM-21 122 mm artillery. MiG-21 aircraft conducted ground-attack and reconnaissance missions, MiG-8 helicopters provided transport and liaison, and ZU-23 and SA-2 systems formed field and airfield defenses. The early SPLA fought primarily as infantry, using AKM and AK-4 rifles, PKM and RPK general-purpose machine guns, SVD Dragunov sniper rifles, DShK heavy machine guns, RPG-7 launchers, and 82 mm and 120 mm mortars. It later received more equipment from Ethiopia and captured T-55 tanks and BMP-1 vehicles, allowing its ground force to expand from battalion and brigade formations into divisions. Ammunition consumption centered on 7.62×39 mm rifle cartridges, 7.62×54 mm machine-gun ammunition, 12.7×54 mm heavy machine-gun ammunition, and 122 mm shells. Ural-375, ZIL-131, and GAZ-66 trucks carried fuel, water, and frontline supplies, although tires, diesel, and the ability to sustain convoys often limited maneuver more directly than firepower alone.
tactics: 1983至1984年間，SPLA以營級突擊群和小型縱隊從埃塞俄比亞邊境進入蘇丹，沿阿孔至皮博爾、邦加至博馬等方向分散推進；夜間接近孤立守軍，奪取武器和糧食後再轉入叢林或高地。政府軍則以步兵師、裝甲旅、機械化旅、炮兵和航空兵協同，由喀土穆沿尼羅河向馬拉卡爾、博爾輸送，或由歐貝伊德經公路向瓦烏推進。MiG-21使公路車隊暴露，Mi-8增加調動速度，但狹窄道路、橋梁、季風泥濘與連續護衛拖慢進軍。1985年至1989年，攻防轉為較成熟的陣地戰：政府軍可以靠裝甲縱隊奪取瓦烏、巴巴努薩等城鎮，卻難以保住通往後方的道路；SPLA以集中步兵、夜間襲擊和預設陣地消耗其推進速度，再切斷孤立車隊。1990年代，雙方都能持續部署師級部隊，SPLA逐步使用繳獲的T-55和BMP-1，政府軍則把MiG-21、D-30與BM-21集中用於突破和掩護。鐵路戰以巴巴努薩至瓦烏走廊為核心，政府企圖切斷SPLA的縱深供應，SPLA則以夜襲車站、奪取鐵路器材和維持西側據點反制。雙方共同瓶頸都是前線彈藥、柴油、輪胎與可靠的無線電中繼，而不是某一種武器本身。
tacticsEn: From 1983 to 1984, SPLA battalion-sized strike groups and small columns entered Sudan from the Ethiopian border and dispersed along routes such as Akon toward Pibor and Bonga toward Boma. They approached isolated garrisons at night, seized weapons and supplies, and then withdrew into woodland or high ground. The government combined infantry divisions, armored and mechanized brigades, artillery, and aviation. It moved from Khartoum up the Nile toward Malakal and Bor, or along the road from El Obeid toward Wau. MiG-21 aircraft exposed convoys to air attack, while Mi-8 helicopters accelerated movement, but narrow roads, bridges, monsoon mud, and continuous escort requirements slowed the advance. Between 1985 and 1989, fighting became a more mature positional struggle. Government armored columns could seize towns such as Wau and Babanusa, but struggled to secure the roads behind them. The SPLA used concentrated infantry, night attacks, and prepared positions to slow those advances, isolate vehicles, and attack supply columns. During the 1990s, both sides could sustain division-scale operations. The SPLA gradually employed captured T-55 tanks and BMP-1 vehicles, while the government concentrated MiG-21 aircraft, D-30 guns, and BM-21 launchers for breakthroughs and covering fires. The Rail War centered on the Babanusa-Wau corridor. The government sought to sever the SPLA's lines of supply, while the SPLA countered with night attacks on stations, seizures of railway equipment, and the maintenance of positions west of the line. For both sides, frontline ammunition, diesel, tires, and dependable radio relay were more immediate constraints than any single weapon.
data: 可核對的時間線從1983年5月18日開始：駐皮博爾的南方部隊首先叛離，同月博馬與阿約德也出現起義；六月，部分武裝人員在埃塞俄比亞一側組織成SPLA。1984年，皮博爾、博爾與馬拉卡爾一線形成反覆攻防，戰線也向瓦烏和巴巴努薩方向延伸。1985年4月6日，尼邁里在喀土穆被軍事政變推翻；同年政府軍發動大規模進攻，試圖切斷SPLA與埃塞俄比亞的聯繫，卻在上尼羅爾與巴赫爾加扎勒受到抵抗。1986年，薩迪克·馬赫迪就任總理；11月28日，政府與SPLM/A在亞的斯亞貝巴簽署諒解備忘錄，但瓦烏、巴巴努薩和托里特等地的戰鬥仍然繼續。1989年6月30日，巴希爾推翻馬赫迪，此後政府改由國家伊斯蘭陣線主導。1991年SPLA發生內部分裂，1992年簽訂的亞的斯亞貝巴和平協議因赤道軍團拒絕接受及政府軍不承認部分條款而無法落實；1993年加朗在控制區宣布新蘇丹。1996至1999年，巴巴努薩至瓦烏的鐵路戰成為主要戰役，雙方反覆爭奪車站、公路和補給線。1999年7月10日，雙方在拉各斯簽署和平進程諒解備忘錄；2000年7月9日，綜合和平協議在奈洛比簽署。部分戰史以1999年拉各斯文件作為戰爭終點，較完整的編年則以2000年協議作為正式收束。
dataEn: The verifiable timeline begins on 18 May 1983, when southern troops at Pibor first mutinied, followed by further mutinies at Boma and Ayod during the same month. In June, armed personnel began organizing the SPLA on the Ethiopian side of the border. In 1984, Pibor, Bor, and Malakal became the scene of repeated attacks and counterattacks, and the front extended toward Wau and Babanusa. On 6 April 1985, Nimeiry was overthrown in a military coup in Khartoum. That year, government forces launched a major offensive to sever the SPLA's links with Ethiopia, but encountered resistance in Upper Nile and Bahr el Ghazal. Sadiq al-Mahdi became prime minister in 1986. On 28 November, the government and the SPLM/A signed a memorandum of understanding in Addis Ababa, yet fighting continued around Wau, Babanusa, Torit, and other towns. On 30 June 1989, Bashir overthrew al-Mahdi, after which the National Islamic Front became the principal political force behind the government. The SPLA split in 1991, and the 1992 Addis Ababa peace agreement could not be implemented because the Equatoria Corps rejected its terms and the government refused to recognize parts of it. In 1993, Garang declared New Sudan in the territory under his control. From 1996 to 1999, the Rail War between Babanusa and Wau became the central campaign, with both sides repeatedly contesting stations, roads, and supply lines. On 10 July 1999, the parties signed the memorandum of understanding on the peace process in Lagos. The Comprehensive Peace Agreement was signed in Nairobi on 9 July 2000. Some chronologies end the war with the 1999 Lagos document, while fuller accounts treat the 2000 agreement as its formal closure.
cause: 直接原因可追溯至1972年的《亞的斯亞貝巴協議》。該協議結束第一次蘇丹內戰，給予南部地方自治與政治機構，並在南方部隊整合進蘇丹武裝力量時保留一定武裝保障。尼邁里在1980年削弱南部自治後，南方軍政人物的整體不信任逐步加深。1983年，軍方決定解散或整編第三步兵師內的南方阿尼亞部隊，把士兵併入全國軍隊並收繳重武器；對 remembers 1972年協議的人而言，這不是普通調防，而是一次可能解除武裝的制度轉向。加朗參與的軍委曾討論軍隊整合與武裝問題，也使尼邁里政府提高戒心。五月的限時繳械命令遂成為起義的觸發點，皮博爾、博馬和阿約德守軍先後脫離原有指揮鏈。加朗等人進入埃塞俄比亞後，邊境庇護、訓練與補給使局部起義得以轉成持續戰爭；同期乍得派系戰爭又增加了跨境武器與後勤通道。
causeEn: The immediate cause can be traced to the 1972 Addis Ababa Agreement, which ended the First Sudanese Civil War, granted southern regional autonomy and political institutions, and preserved certain armed guarantees as southern troops were integrated into the Sudanese armed forces. After Nimeiry weakened southern autonomy in 1980, distrust among southern military and political leaders steadily deepened. In 1983, the military decided to dissolve or reorganize the southern Anyanya units within the Third Infantry Division, incorporate their soldiers into the national army, and confiscate their heavy weapons. To those who remembered the 1972 agreement, this was not an ordinary redeployment but a institutional reversal that could disarm the south. A military commission in which Garang participated had discussed integration and armed-force questions, further increasing the regime's suspicion. The limited deadline for handing over weapons in May therefore became the trigger for mutiny, and southern garrisons at Pibor, Boma, and Ayod broke with their existing command structure. After Garang and others entered Ethiopia, border sanctuary, training, and supply converted a local mutiny into a sustained war. At the same time, factional fighting in Chad expanded cross-border weapons and logistics routes.
impact: 軍事上，蘇丹政府始終保有米格-21、Mi-8、裝甲部隊與較完整炮兵體系，卻未能長期控制南部公路和鐵路沿線；SPLA則由邊界游擊力量發展成能持續使用砲兵、裝甲車與師級縱隊的常規軍。雙方都受制於道路、河流渡口、燃料、彈藥與輪胎，前線補給線一旦被切斷，裝甲優勢便難以轉成控制。瓦烏、巴巴努薩和上尼羅爾的反覆攻防改變了雙方部署，1991年的內部分裂更使SPLA主派同時面對政府軍與赤道軍團。道路、橋梁、鐵路設施、燃料庫和通信節點反覆受損，政府軍必須分散原本可用於北部集結的部隊，SPLA也必須把大量車輛與兵員投入長距離補給。政治上，尼邁里倒台、馬赫迪的和平嘗試、巴希爾與國家伊斯蘭陣線掌權，以及加朗宣布新蘇丹，均直接改變戰爭的談判結構。由於早期戰報常把作戰損失、逃亡、失聯與後勤損失混列，可核實的全戰傷亡總數互相矛盾，因此本實錄不列未能交叉驗證的精確傷亡數字。
impactEn: Militarily, the Sudanese government retained MiG-21 aircraft, Mi-8 helicopters, armored formations, and a more complete artillery system, but it could not hold the southern roads and railway corridor for long. The SPLA developed from a border-based guerrilla force into a conventional army capable of sustained artillery operations, armored movement, and division-scale columns. Both sides remained constrained by roads, river crossings, fuel, ammunition, and tires; once a supply line was cut, armored superiority could not readily be converted into lasting control. Repeated fighting around Wau, Babanusa, and Upper Nile changed both sides' deployments, while the SPLA split of 1991 forced its main faction to fight both the government and the Equatoria Corps. Roads, bridges, railway facilities, fuel depots, and communications nodes were repeatedly damaged. The government had to disperse troops that might otherwise have been concentrated in the north, and the SPLA had to commit vehicles and personnel to long-distance supply. Politically, Nimeiry's fall, al-Mahdi's peace initiatives, Bashir and the National Islamic Front's accession to power, and Garang's declaration of New Sudan directly altered the structure of negotiations. Because early reports frequently combined combat losses, desertions, missing personnel, and logistical losses, published overall casualty totals conflict and cannot be reliably verified; this account therefore does not reproduce uncertain precision.
result: 1998至1999年，政府軍在巴巴努薩至瓦烏走廊發動最後幾次大規模攻勢，以裝甲縱隊、炮兵與MiG-21支援掩護，試圖切斷SPLA的西側據點與供應線；SPLA利用既有陣地、夜間突擊和對車站與公路的控制，使政府軍無法取得決定性突破。SPLA同期向歐貝伊德與喀土穆外圍推進，一度進入奧姆杜爾曼南緣，但未能攻取首都。到1999年拉各斯談判時，政府仍控制喀土穆與北段尼羅河，SPLA則掌握大部分南部、西部及重要鐵路節點，雙方都無法把軍事成果轉為全面政治勝利。2000年7月9日簽署的綜合和平協議規定停火、權力分享、建立南蘇丹自治地區並在約定期限內舉行自決公投，同時安排SPLA與政府軍整合。戰後加朗返回喀土穆主持過渡權力安排，SPLA改編為南蘇丹國防軍，大規模有組織的國家軍與SPLA戰爭至此結束。其後的治理衝突、南蘇丹於2011年的獨立，以及SPLA成為南蘇丹國家軍隊，均是這段1983至2000年戰爭留下的制度與軍事後果。
resultEn: From 1998 to 1999, government forces mounted their last major offensives along the Babanusa-Wau corridor, using armored columns, artillery, and MiG-21 support to try to cut the SPLA's western positions and supply routes. The SPLA used prepared positions, night attacks, and control of stations and roads to prevent the government from achieving a decisive breakthrough. At the same time, SPLA forces advanced toward El Obeid and the outskirts of Khartoum, reaching the southern edge of Omdurman without taking the capital. By the time of the 1999 Lagos negotiations, the government still controlled Khartoum and the northern Nile, while the SPLA held most of the south and west along with important railway nodes; neither side could convert military gains into a complete political victory. The Comprehensive Peace Agreement signed on 9 July 2000 provided for a ceasefire, power sharing, an autonomous Southern Sudan with a referendum on self-determination within a defined period, and the integration of the SPLA and government forces. Garang subsequently returned to Khartoum to lead the transitional arrangement, and the SPLA was reorganized as the Southern Sudan Defence Forces, bringing the large-scale organized war between the Sudanese state and the SPLA to a formal end. Subsequent political disputes, South Sudan's independence in 2011, and the SPLA's transformation into the national army of South Sudan were institutional and military consequences of the war that began in 1983 and was formally closed in 2000.
